title: Tech Finance Specialist
full_description:
At ING we are looking for Tech Finance Specialist
Your role and work environment:
We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Tech Finance Specialist to join our CoEof Governance and Operational excellence in theTeam of TechFinance
The responsibility of this team is to guarantee governance, effectiveness and consistency in operational execution and transversal activities within the CIO Domain, to meet our strategy and targets.
Your key responsibilities:
As a Tech Finance Specialist you will:
-Perform monthly financial closing activities, cash flow and expense analysis, ensuring the accuracy of the actuals.
-Facilitate, support, and consolidate the budgeting and forecasting processes.
-Monitor costs and carry out all analyses required to identify risks and opportunities and to propose the appropriate actions.
-Support on Business Case construction for new initiatives.
-Simplify processes to achieve operational efficiency.
-Manage the purchase orders processes to properly account for IT spend.
We expect you, with all these responsibilities, to ultimately contribute to the Tech and Finance strategy of the Bank.
What are we looking for?
Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply!
Ideally 3 to 5 years of professional experience in FP&A, Controlling, or Financial Analysis, preferably within a Tech or Digital environment.
Ability to manage financial activities (month-end, forecasting, etc.), ensuring accuracy in data reporting.
Strong analytical skills to monitor costs, identify risks/opportunities, and support budgeting and forecasting processes.
Genuine interest in Technology and Innovation, with the ability to understand IT spending (Software, Hardware, Cloud) and translate it into financial insights.
Advanced Excel skills are mandatory. Experience with other data tools (e.g. Power BI) will be valued.
Fluent in English, spoken and written.
Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or other similar education which comprises financial and numerical knowledge.
Proactive mindset with a focus on simplifying processes to achieve operational efficiency.
Strong communication skills to manage several stakeholders (Tech, Finance, Transformation office, etc.).
Attention to detail and ability to deliver top-quality analysis.
Enthusiasm and ambition to learn.
The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.
Check out what is waiting for you!
Be flexible my friend.
Our model is all about flexibility and accountability. Keeping both our customers and our colleagues’ needs in mind, you determine together which days you work at home and which you come to ING MAD to offer your best self. Do your thing.
So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.
Our house will be your home.
In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!
For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).
We help you protect what matters most to you.
Flexible remuneration.
In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…
Free company shuttle.
It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably.

And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!
